name: tool_git_branch_before_editing
description: A change should land on a feature branch, not committed straight to main - graded on where the commit actually lands (main_commit_count), not on guessing the branch name the model picks.
prompts: We're about to add a new feature to app.py. First list the branches to confirm where we are, then set up a feature branch for this work before committing - don't commit straight to main.
